concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Complete the study and validate its evidence
concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) includes a 'Power analysis & sample size' element, but no task explicitly generates or documents the power analysis that determines the simulated sample size (128 per group). A task should be added (e.g., T012) that performs the a priori power calculation and records the rationale in the metadata.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Complete the study and validate its evidence
concerns.text: The plan specifies that a covariate‑adjusted linear model must be fitted (see 'Covariate adjustment' row in the plan mapping), yet no task description or tag mentions implementing this adjusted analysis. Add a task (e.g., T013) that runs the adjusted model and records its results.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Setup and first end‑to‑end analysis (simulation‑first)
concerns.text: Constitution principle VII requires preservation of raw WCST trial logs. The current tasks (T002, T011) only mention generating an aggregated CSV; there is no task that creates or stores the raw trial‑by‑trial logs. Add a task (e.g., T014) to generate and archive these raw behavioral logs alongside the aggregated dataset.
